segments.name: North America
segments.description: Sells coffee, beverages and food through company-operated and licensed coffeehouses in the U.S. and Canada.
segments.evidence: North America and International operations sell coffee and other beverages, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve coffee products, and a focused selection of merchandise through company-operated coffeehouses and licensed coffeehouses.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Sells coffee, beverages and food through company-operated and licensed coffeehouses in China, Japan, Asia Pacific, Europe and other markets.
segments.evidence: North America and International operations sell coffee and other beverages, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve coffee products, and a focused selection of merchandise through company-operated coffeehouses and licensed coffeehouses.

segments.name: Channel Development
products: roasted whole bean and ground coffees
segments.description: Sells packaged coffee, tea, foodservice products and ready-to-drink beverages to customers outside its coffeehouses, mostly through Nestlé.
segments.evidence: Channel Development revenues include packaged coffee, tea, foodservice products, and ready-to-drink beverage sales to customers outside of our company-operated and licensed coffeehouses.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for beverages and food at company-operated and licensed coffeehouses, which generate most of the revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate the majority of our revenues through company-operated coffeehouses and licensed coffeehouses.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, Starbucks divested its China retail operations and converted them to a licensed joint venture model.
changes.evidence: The fiscal year 2026 balances reflect the impact of divesting Starbucks retail operations in China during the third quarter of fiscal 2026.
